name: CCS Combo 2
description: Combined AC/DC charging interface: configuration FF of IEC 62196-3. The vehicle inlet combines a Type 2 AC section with two DC contacts below it; the DC vehicle connector keeps only PE, CP, PP and the two DC contacts.

electricalProfiles.name: DC
conditions: Maximum rating of configuration FF in IEC 62196-3:2022 (edition 2.0), tables 302 and 303.
IEC 62196-3:2026 (edition 3.0) announces increased ratings for all configurations; the configuration FF values of that edition could not be reviewed and are not recorded here.
Products are rated individually and may be lower; for example one non-cooled inlet datasheet gives 200 A permanent.
Used only with DC EV supply equipment of System C (IEC 61851-23 Annex CC).
CP and PP are signal contacts rated 30 V, 2 A.

notes: DC ratings come from the 2022 edition (1000 V, 400 A): the configuration FF ratings of IEC 62196-3:2026 could not be sourced. Checked on 2026-11-08: the IEC webstore page (webstore.iec.ch/en/publication/86314) gives the abstract, the publication date 2026-04-23, Corrigendum 1 (2026-08) and the change list ('increased ratings for all configurations') but no figure; the iTeh English preview (cdn.standards.iteh.ai/.../cbf4dcef.../iec62196-3-ed3-0-en.pdf) and the bilingual preview (cdn.standards.iteh.ai/.../4fc7035b.../iec-62196-3-2026.pdf) stop at page 13, after Table 301, which lists only the DC configurations AA, BB and GG; the technickenormy.cz preview (publicdoc/iec_previews/4307460.pdf) and the VDE preview (info_iec62196-3{ed3.0}en.pdf) give the same 13 pages, whose contents place the FF ratings in Table 302 (page 14), Table 303 (page 16), Table 307 (page 60) and Annex AA.5 (page 92); the ANSI preview URL returned an HTML page; web searches (including CharIN) found no document quoting the 2026 FF values.

The 1500 V / 600 A values and the note that products deployed according to Annex AA can exceed 600 A, in Table 301 of the 2026 preview, apply to configuration GG, not to configuration FF; they are not recorded here.
Liquid-cooled ratings (IEC 62196-3:2026 Annex AA, formerly IEC TS 62196-3-1) are not modelled: the Annex AA ratings (AA.5) are outside the available preview.

The DC vehicle connector contact set is taken from the standard's optional AC contacts and secondary sources. Its face is not drawn: no source depicting the DC vehicle connector face could be read. The manufacturer datasheets with a vehicle connector pin assignment (Phoenix Contact DC charging cables via phoenixcontact.com, Mouser and TME; HARTING CCS Type 2 cable technical data) were refused (HTTP 403) or no longer available, and the Phoenix Contact 1427757 datasheet only shows the inlet face.
